entry.title: Cipr and Ciprnode zero
entry.summary: The Cipr (Cosmic Index of Public Resources) is a decentralized, distributed, and censorship-resistant web index where domain owners control their own entries. No crawler decides if you are worth indexing. No curator approves your submission. No central authority can delist you. If you own a domain, you publish a small daemon, add a DNS TXT record, and your site is in the index, worldwide, in minutes. Updating your entry or leaving for good is also quick and easy. The Cipr is not a search engine in the traditional sense. It is a shared, peer-to-peer directory where every participant holds a full copy and keeps it in sync through viral propagation. Search results are ranked by standardized, publicly auditable factors (BM25 over owner-declared metadata), not by opaque algorithms or ad revenue…
